proposals.expected_signal: If recent gains are driven by brittle popularity amplification rather than true collaborative structure, adding constraint-weighted penalties on high-degree item exposure should cause a sharp NDCG@10落
proposals.failure_mode: No measurable degradation because the penalty is too weak relative to the frozen protocol, or degradation is uniform and non-diagnostic across head and tail items.
proposals.hypothesis: The current search region may be over-crediting graph propagation wins that mainly exploit head-item degree bias. A constraint-weighted objective that suppresses high-popularity attraction should selectively break such models and reveal whether their ranking quality is structurally fragile.
